entries.description: FX revaluation of EUR cash balance to period-end rate

findings.message: The entry books 11,200.00 of revaluation on 1110 (EUR), but recalculating from the trial balance and the given rates does not reproduce it (from period average rate 1.082: EUR 825,400.00 x (1.095 - 1.082) = 10,730.20; from opening rate 1.071: EUR 825,400.00 x (1.095 - 1.071) = 19,809.60). Also, if the trial balance is translated at the period-end rate anyway, this entry would count the revaluation twice. [Acknowledged by Controller (demo): Treasury confirmed 11,200 uses the 30-Dec bank rate; TB foreign rows will be translated excluding this reval.]
findings.fix: Share the revaluation workings and confirm whether TB foreign rows are in local currency.
